accuracy_gate.policy: no worse than frozen train-mean predictor on identical test cohort

assessment_scope: retrospective predictive rule comparison; mechanism and novelty not established
custody: test outputs accessible only to evaluator; not independent new evidence
observation_window: Issue predictions at120s of each current-free block; only actual samples at or before10/60/120s and completed preceding current pulse are predictors. Targets are nearest native samples to300/600/1200/1800s, tolerance15s.

preprocessing.measurements: inherited native measurements and permitted calibrated features; see source lineage

split.independent_unit: Complete rest block linked to preceding current pulse; all blocks belong to one half-cell, so block summaries are not independent-cell confidence.
split.policy: deterministic whole independent-unit groups; original confirmation unchanged

stability.scope: diagnostic only; measurement error distribution not independently established

title: voltage during current-free relaxation
